title: IBM Sterling File Gateway 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1 and 6.2.2.0 - 6.2.2.1_1 could allow a remote attacker to perform…
description: IBM Sterling File Gateway versions 6.2.1.0 through 6.2.1.2_1 and 6.2.2.0 through 6.2.2.1_1 contain a security misconfiguration that could allow a remote attacker to perform protocol downgrade attacks. This vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 6.5. No patch or remediation details are currently provided.
